study.question: At nearly matched dense parameter counts, does protecting the buy tower second layer preserve click AUC better than protecting its first layer, and does that ordering survive dimension-corrected initialization?
study.hypothesis: Observed layer sensitivity is a provisional capacity-allocation hypothesis, not established compression utility. Under inherited initialization g2-r0049-joint_layer_reference AUC=0.6671669182, first96/64=0.6669282618, second112/48=0.6662416908, both96/48=0.6665210136. Removing the second-layer channels loses more AUC despite removing fewer parameters. Predict that [108,64] outperforms nearly parameter-matched [112,48], because the 64-dimensional nonlinear representation of the context-owning buy task may preserve useful shared-context updates. Only buy can send auxiliary gradients to context; scorer/item detach gates remain fixed. Earlier g2-r0048 results show initialization scale changes outcomes, so crossing both allocations with inherited versus corrected Xavier variance is required. This mechanism remains unverified; no claim of independent seed support or architecture novelty.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary text read at lines 219-299, including field embeddings, concatenated MLP, target-dependent local activation, and unnormalized activation weights. Inherit those ideas through the adapted local code. This study tests marginal allocation inside an existing four-task compressed-history implementation; it does not reproduce the original DIN training or propose a new attention architecture.

Read complete supplied standalone implementation and its latest factorial receipts. Earlier factorial removed 16 first-layer or 16 second-layer channels with unequal parameter costs. This proposal compares [108,64] against [112,48] at 202667 versus202691 dense parameters and crosses allocation with existing deterministic variance correction.

Earlier capacity-by-scale trial changed both hidden widths together. Its 0.6668040944 AUC versus reduced inherited 0.6665210136 motivates controlling scale; no evidence that this scale response transfers to the new allocation is assumed.

predictions: Primary predeclared allocation prediction: AUC(first108)-AUC(second48) >=0.0001 within each initialization scale. Report both differences and the difference-in-differences; opposite signs count against a scale-robust allocation mechanism.

Prospective screening preservation gate: click AUC >=0.666653547526167 (entry g0-r0022 AUC minus0.0001) AND >=0.6670669182126774 (unchanged g2-r0049 reference minus0.0001). The stricter threshold protects accumulated gains. Do not relax after results; these are new prospective gates, not claims about unknown prior gates.

Utility additionally requires actual dense/total Parameters below the unchanged full reference and measured model-only p50 at least2% lower, p95 no higher, full-validation inference seconds no higher, and train_seconds no more than2% higher, under matched conditions. Report whole-model parameters including unchanged31793216 embeddings; parameter/MAC reduction alone does not satisfy utility.

This four-cell screen has historical full-width timing only. Any apparent efficiency gain is provisional until a contemporaneous unchanged/full-width control and paired repetitions confirm it. If unavailable, report cost uncertainty without selecting an efficiency winner.

Report all four AUC/Logloss values, click and auxiliary mean separately, memory, training/inference times, throughput, and model-only p50/p95. Pre-existing history-length slices are exploratory, include sample/positive/negative counts and mark insufficient slices; do not use slice winners for selection.

Exact inherited second48 replay must match g2-r0049-joint_layer_second48 AUC0.6662416907813548 and all task metrics under the unchanged host. Repeated identical AUC is execution reliability, not seed variation.
falsifiers: Failure of first108 to beat second48 by0.0001 under both scales falsifies the stated robust allocation prediction for these choices; a sign reversal implicates initialization interaction.
AUC below either preservation threshold rejects candidate utility even if the allocation contrast is positive.
No reproducible measured prediction-cost reduction, or training-time regression above2%, rejects efficiency utility despite smaller tensors.
Forward/backward/masking, source-ownership, parameter-accounting, buffer or exact-replay failures invalidate scientific interpretation until corrected; retain costs.
A positive single-seed screen that reverses in later authorized paired seeds lacks repeated support. This does not refute all possible capacity allocations.
alternative_explanations: Different channel identities and nonlinear feature geometry remain coupled to layer allocation; 24 parameters are unmatched
Corrected Xavier marginal variances do not equate functions, Dice populations, gradient norms or optimization
Global dense gradient clipping can couple private heads to shared updates
Single training seed and one validation date; same-seed reruns reproduce trajectories but are not independent support
Small dense differences may be hidden by embedding, history/scorer, loading and timing overhead

Earlier broad cuts were unsuccessful: g2-r0024-joint_embedding12 AUC0.6641111849, joint_scorer_half0.6654368616, and g2-r0025-joint_tower_half0.6654569217. These are valid executions and negative scientific outcomes, not missing data.

The abandoned shared projection/reuse branch g2-r0031-joint_projection_shared_reuse reached0.6648248738 despite fewer parameters. The later private-head assignment g2-r0044-joint_assignment_preferred preserves0.6671669182 with204531 dense Parameters; its success does not imply the buy gradient path is dispensable.

Runtime noise is material: unchanged owner references inference seconds26.987,25.125,25.398 across recent replays; first96/64 improves aggregate seconds but p50 worsens slightly versus its paired reference. No stable speed advantage is established.

No execution failure appears in the supplied recent history and previous_runtime_error is null; do not invent failed jobs. No data/torch execution is available in the coding workspace, so readiness checks beyond static/source inspection are deferred to the authorized host.
